music: Cinematic Southeast Asian score, instrumental. Opens sparse and intimate: a soft solo khaen (Lao bamboo mouth organ) over a low sustained drone, slow tempo. Around 37 seconds a frame drum and a bowed fiddle drone enter and the khaen states a four-note rising motif that never resolves, wide and warm but uneasy. A darker undertone builds toward the end, then it holds an unresolved chord.
Solo khaen (Lao bamboo mouth organ), slow and open, contemplative and quiet, unresolved phrases with space between them, natural room reverb, instrumental.
A curious, questioning cue, instrumental: soft plucked Thai phin lute in a low register over a quiet bowed drone, sparse and slow, a little uneasy, a gentle tension that never resolves.

A tight anxious pulse, instrumental: a low frame drum beating like a racing heartbeat under tense sustained bowed strings, dissonant and unsettling, pressure building, then thinning to a numb low drone at the end.
Solo Thai phin lute, gentle and warm, a calm unhurried melody, quiet acceptance, a little wistful, instrumental.
One soft sustained chord on khaen and low strings, unresolved, slowly fading to silence, instrumental.
Thai luk thung country music, instrumental: twangy phin lute, khaen, accordion and a light upbeat rhythm section, cheerful and nostalgic, lo-fi.

A low ominous drone that slowly rises in pitch and intensity over forty seconds: bowed cello and viola tremolo over a deep reed drone like a khaen held on one chord, dark and tense, no drums, no melody, swelling toward the end, instrumental.
